Artist: Elvie Shane · Title: My Boy · Album: Backslider · Year: 2021 · Genre: Country · Path: /Users/bobhopp/DJ MEDIA/VIDEO/COUNTRY/FILL/Elvie Shane - My Boy.mp4
"My Boy" is the debut single by American country music singer Elvie Shane.
It was released to country radio on September 21, 2020.
It is the first single from his debut album Backslider, which was released on October 29, 2021.
Elvie Shane (born May 22, 1988) is an American country music singer.
He is signed to BBR Music Group and in 2020 he released his debut single "My Boy", which has charted on Country Airplay.
Shane was born in Caneyville, Kentucky, where he grew up singing in his church and listening to country music that his father played.

Shane wrote the song with Lee Starr, Nick Columbia, and Russell Sutton, while Oscar Charles produced it.

Shane said: "I took that to a few of my friends, and I resonated with that being a step father myself, and 3 out of the 4 of us that wrote it could identify with the song somehow." On June 15, 2022, the Recording Industry Association of America certified the song platinum.
